text:
Taylor: Hey team - baby arrived via surrogacy yesterday! I want to add the newborn to my Redwood benefits. The birth certificate currently lists the surrogate as the mother (state issued) What do I need to get the kid onto my plan? 
Ivy (People Ops): Congrats, @Taylor!! :tada: Short version: For surrogacy births we usually need either an amended birth certificate listing you/your spouse as parent or a court-issued parentage order (parentage judgment) that names the intended parents. If the certificate still lists the surrogate, a parentage order will do.
Taylor: Cool. Is that a QLE so I have 30 days to add? Or do we have to wait for the final order? Im worried about claim gaps.
Sam (Benefits): It is a QLE (birth). You should initiate dependent enrollment within 30 days of birth. However carriers typically require proof of parentage for enrollment if the certificate doesn't show the covered parent. So upload whatever you have now (hospital birth record, newborn SSN application receipt if you applied) and then submit the parentage order once it's finalized. We can provisionally enroll pending documentation in many cases to avoid gaps.
BenefitsBot: KB: https://redwood.example.com/kb/benefits/surrogacy-parentage - lists docs and timelines (amended BC, parentage order, hospital record, SSN application).
Taylor: What counts as provisional enrollment? Will premiums start immediately or only after we provide documents?
Ivy (People Ops): We can mark the dependent as "pending docs" so coverage is effective as of DOB for claim purposes while you provide court docs. Premiums may begin on the effective date (usually the first payroll after enrollment is processed). If docs come late and we have to remove/re-add, we handle retro premium/proration and claims adjustments.
Taylor: Surrogate was in a different state and Im told parentage orders might take 6-8 weeks. Any tips? Do we need an apostille if the birth happened abroad?
Legal (People Ops): If the birth or parentage order is out of state, we accept court orders from the issuing jurisdiction. For foreign births or foreign parentage orders you'll likely need an apostille/translation. If the process will exceed 30 days we still recommend submitting hospital records + intent to parent affidavit and the SSN application receipt; we can flag the case and keep coverage from lapsing. We can also provide an employer letter for hospital billing if needed.
Taylor: I uploaded hospital discharge, newborn footprint form, and a note that parentage order is pending. How will payroll handle premiums if the order arrives later and changes effective parent?
Sam (Benefits): Payroll/proration: premiums generally start the payroll period after enrollment. If we later confirm that the dependent should have been covered retroactively, Benefits will request a premium correction and Payroll will issue credits/refunds in the next 1-2 pay cycles. If we need to remove due to documentation failure, Payroll processes refunds per policy. Keep copies of any out-of-pocket bills for claims appeals.
Taylor: If the surrogate signs an assignment of parentage or a voluntary relinquishment, does that speed things up?
Legal (People Ops): Yes - voluntary relinquishment signed and notarized plus a pre-birth parentage order (if available) can expedite carriers. Some states allow pre-birth orders naming intended parents; if you have that, upload it. If not, the final post-birth parentage judgment is the key doc.
Taylor: Anything else I should do right now to avoid denial at doctor's visits? Pediatrician is asking for insurance card.
Ivy (People Ops): We can generate a temporary coverage confirmation letter after you submit the initial docs (hospital record + SSN application receipt or intent affidavit). Bring that + your insurance card to the pediatrician. If a claim gets billed to the surrogate's name, well work COB with that carrier once parentage order is filed.
Taylor: Uploaded hospital docs + a note "Taylor / case SP-4456 - parentage order pending". Appreciate the help.
Sam (Benefits): Case SP-4456 created. We'll provisionally enroll the dependent and follow up if we need the final order. Expect email updates within 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
Taylor: Thanks all  relieved to have coverage lined up.
